title: Multimodal CT radiomics and 2.5D deep learning for preoperative grading of clear cell renal cell carcinoma in older patients: a multicenter study.
summary: Four-center study reports test-cohort radiomics and deep-learning AUCs around 0.71–0.76. Published in Frontiers in Oncology.
ai_technology: Stacked clinical, radiomics, and 2.5D deep-learning features for preoperative ccRCC grading.
organization: First Hospital of Shanxi Medical University; Shanxi Medical University; Shanxi Provincial People’s Hospital; Shanxi Bethune Hospital

evidence.tested: Internal plus two external cohorts are described; older-patient subgroup is the target scope.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study.
evidence.ai_role: Stacked clinical, radiomics, and 2.5D deep-learning features for preoperative ccRCC grading.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
